versions.fallback: one artifact family (a Longshot mod folder) serves every Longshot release whose Modding API is 0.1: the mod probes has('capture.frame')/has('game.pause')/hideGameHud and degrades per subsystem; the feature floor is photo mode (free camera) with capture listed in the log until the capture seam lands (see seams.md). A mod written for API 0.2 would need its own api pin.
